title: Remote Account Executive / Sr. Account Executive- Greensboro, NC
description:
Q1Media is hiring!
Q1Media is seeking a hardworking, ambitious self-starter with a minimum of three years of experience in media or advertising sales. This role is fully remote, with occasional travel within your territory and to our Austin headquarters.
About Q1Media

Founded in 2004, Q1Media is a digital media sales and services company recognized for excellence and culture. We’ve been named one of the Best Companies to Work For in Texas and a Best Place to Work in Central Texas multiple years running, along with numerous other awards.
As a remote-first company, we value flexibility and work-life integration while working toward a mission of delivering world-class media services and campaign execution for our agency and brand partners. Our team is guided by four Core Values: Earning Trust, Delivering Results, Learning and Being Curious, and Paying it Forward. Headquartered in Austin, TX, Q1Media has a nationwide presence with team members across the country.
Details

• Position: Account Executive/Senior Account Executive, Full-Time

• Location: Greensboro, NC (Must be located in the Greensboro/ High Point/ Winston-Salem area)

• Hours: 9 am-6 pm (flexible)

• Compensation: Salary commensurate with experience, potential bonuses and incentives, medical and dental benefits (no qualifying period), 401 (k)

• Perks: 18+ paid holidays per year, PTO starting at 20 days (prorated for the first year), Fit Perk Program, EAP, parental leave benefits for birthing and non-birthing parents, company-paid Life & ADD Insurance

• Environment: Fun, ambitious, and driven - Q1Media ’s strong culture and year-over-year growth come from our people. We foster a workplace that inspires excellence, connection, and community through company gatherings, team events, and volunteer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Quickly become well-versed in our industry-leading products and services across video, mobile, display, search & social, and streaming advertising.

• Demonstrate clear ability to prospect and drive the acquisition of new relationships.

• Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with advertising agencies, brands, and programmatic buyers nationwide.

• Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual expectations for activity and revenue goals.

• Take ownership of accounts to ensure success in collaboration with the Account Operations team

• Collaborating with your fellow colleagues to drive success through teamwork

• Other duties as assigned

Job Requirements

• 3+ years, minimum, in media or advertising sales

• Ability to articulate a strong understanding of digital advertising campaign strategies

• Strong prospecting skills

• Masterful presentation and negotiation skills, both in-person, over the phone, and via video conference

• Wide network and existing relationships with brands, agencies, DSPs and/or trading desks

• Must work or have worked in market and have existing relationships

• Proven track record of driving revenue at a competitive level

• Availability for light travel and willingness to entertain clients on a regular basis

Compensation

• Competitive base salary

• Uncapped commission on all booked revenue

• Monthly and quarterly incentives/bonuses

• Annual and semi-annual incentives (Includes paid trips, spending cash, and/or additional PTO)

Q1Media is a subsidiary of Ionik (TXS:INIK), a Canadian-based corporation uniting a seasoned group of digital advertising leaders to energize new possibilities for brand growth and performance.
Q1Media is committed to an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We provide equal opportunities and prohibit discrimination or harassment of any kind, ensuring fairness and respect for all.
Q1Media does not currently provide employment visa sponsorship.

title: Partner Enablement + Program Manager, Startups
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the open-source backend platform trusted by millions of developers to build web apps, SaaS products, and AI-native applications. Our Partnerships team works across the ecosystem - technology partners, cloud platforms, VCs, accelerators, and startup programs - to make Supabase the default backend for the next generation of companies.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Startup Partner Enablement & Programs Manager to bring our partner ecosystem to life through enablement, events, and programs to raise awareness of Supabase's value proposition to early stage startups. You'll own the materials, playbooks, and activations that help our partners - VCs, accelerators, incubators and entrepreneurship programs - successfully promote and build with Supabase. That includes organizing Supabase's presence at partner and VC-related events, running office hours, hackathons and VIP dinners, and turning relationships into repeatable, high-impact programs.

This role sits on the Partnerships team and reports to the Head of Startups, working closely with teammates across the startup program, GTM, developer relations, and marketing. Because the bulk of our events and partner activity is concentrated in San Francisco and the Bay Area, we strongly prefer candidates based there who can regularly attend and host events in person. It's a great fit for someone who loves the operational craft of enablement and programs and wants to work at the intersection of startups, venture, and developer tools.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and maintain partner enablement materials - decks, one-pagers, playbooks, and activation guides - that help partners across the ecosystem promote and build with Supabase

- Manage the operational cadence of partner programs: collaborating on strategy, tracking activations, and keeping program logistics running smoothly across partner types

- Organize Supabase's presence at partner and VC-related events - demo days, founder summits, portfolio workshops, partner conferences - including sourcing and preparing speakers for talks and panels

- Plan and run Supabase hackathons end-to-end: partner coordination, logistics, sponsorships, judging, prizes, promotion, and post-event follow-through

- Coordinate cross-functionally with the Partnerships, Startups, GTM, DevRel, Events and Marketing teams to align enablement and event activity with pipeline goals

- Measure and report on program impact - signups, credit redemptions, partner-sourced pipeline, and event outcomes

- Identify new enablement and program opportunities across the partner ecosystem and bring proposals with clear ROI to the team

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3-5 years of experience in partner enablement, program management, event marketing, or partner marketing - ideally in developer tools, startups, or venture ecosystems

- A track record of running events (hackathons, meetups, conferences, or workshops) from planning through post-event reporting

- Strong project management instincts: you keep many moving pieces on track without dropping details

- Comfort working and communicating with external stakeholders - technology partners, VCs, accelerators, community leaders - and representing the company professionally

- Clear written and verbal communication; you can produce polished enablement materials and brief a speaker with equal ease

- A bias toward measurement: you instinctively ask "did this move the needle?" and build metrics-based reporting to answer it

- Comfortable in a fast-moving, remote-first environment with a high degree of autonomy

- Based in (or willing to relocate to) the San Francisco Bay Area, with availability for regular in-person events, including occasional evenings and weekends

NICE TO HAVE

- Familiarity with the developer tools landscape, AI infrastructure, and/or hands-on experience with databases like Supabase, Postgres, or similar products

- Experience working with startup accelerators (e.g., YC, Techstars) or VC pl

title: Principal Software Engineer - Performance Tuning - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch Performance team. In this role, you will lead architectural and code-level performance engineering initiatives. Your goal is to drive the continuous optimization and predictability of Elasticsearch performance, partnering with area-specific teams to unlock the full potential of our software.

What You Will Be Doing

• Owning core performance engineering initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of high-impact optimizations. Leading the technical design, plan, and execution for major architectural and code-level performance improvements.

• Developing foundational performance models and methodologies for complex, distributed systems.

• Driving optimization strategies to ensure Elasticsearch remains performant, predictable, and scalable in diverse environments.

• Profiling and analyzing system behavior to identify bottlenecks in logging, metrics, vector search, and ES|QL.

• Ensuring robust performance benchmarks and regression detection for both stateful and stateless (Serverless) architectures.

• Collaborating across the company to embed performance-first thinking into new features from the outset.

• Drive automation efforts by designing and building AI-assisted optimization harnesses that streamline profiling, hypothesis testing, and benchmarking.

• Mentoring and coaching other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and performance-aware development.

What You Bring

• You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.

• You have proven experience in profiling and optimizing distributed systems. This includes deep experience with benchmarking tools (e.g.,flamegraphs, JMH, Rally), identifying performance regressions, and implementing algorithmic or hardware-aware optimizations.

• You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems architecture, including partition tolerance, cluster state propagation, and scaling challenges in large-scale data stores.

• You have a proven track record of using AI or advanced tooling to accelerate optimization, debug complex performance issues, and automate benchmarking workflows.

• You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams, acting as a force multiplier for performance engineering across the organization.

• You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities

• You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

• Experience integrating high-performance native libraries (e.g., C++, Rust, SIMD-accelerated code) into Java applications.

• Deep knowledge of modern storage engine performance, index modes, or vector search optimizations.

title: Engineering Manager: Agentic Integrations
description:

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on the Agentic Integrations team, you’ll lead engineers building and scaling integrations for Constructor’s agentic products across our customer base. This team sits within the ML Journey chapter and operates at the intersection of customer needs, applied ML, product engineering, and production integration work.

Your team will work directly with customers and internal teams to bring agentic capabilities into real-world retail workflows, helping customers adopt, configure, extend, and scale these products in their environments. The work spans two fronts: delivering high-quality customer integrations for agentic products, and turning repeated implementation patterns into reusable tooling, frameworks, documentation, and platform capabilities that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

You’ll be responsible for setting the technical and operational direction for the team: how we engage customers, how we make integration work scalable, how we maintain quality across a growing number of deployments, and how we turn customer-specific learnings into product and platform improvements. Success in this role requires strong engineering leadership, customer empathy, excellent prioritization, and the ability to work effectively across Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and core Engineering teams.

title: Manager, Risk Operations Technology Programs
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Operations Technology Enablement team sits within the Risk Operations org and is responsible for partnering across Risk teams to shape the technical infrastructure that enables us to scale our Risk operations and achieve our dual goals of preventing bad actors from exploiting Stripe’s systems and delivering an exceptional user experience for legitimate users. More specifically, our team partners with Risk product and engineering teams to identify, scope, prioritize, pilot, and roll out technical infrastructure and tooling improvements to protect Stripe and serve our users. From the application of AI to our reviews, to agent diagnostic and resolution tools, to review and support case routing, to our user-facing risk support surfaces, our team’s mandate is expansive and a major lever in both protecting Stripe and its users from risk as well as improving the user experience.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead and develop a high-performing team of Engineering Program Managers who deliver technical programs with step-change impact for Stripe. You’ll build strong partnerships and operating mechanisms with Risk Engineering and Product, co-develop the strategy for Risk’s technical infrastructure grounded in a deep understanding of the Risk technology stack, and own mission-critical technical processes (e.g., Risk Ops tooling-stack prioritization).

Responsibilities

• Shape and drive alignment on Risk Operations’ technical strategy that enables us to achieve our ambitious top-line goals 

• Partners cross-functionally across Risk (eng, product, operations) to set and execute against our technical roadmap 

• Coach a team of high-performing, engineering program managers to effectively lead technical programs; this includes providing consistent coaching, setting vision and goals, holding the team to a high-bar, fostering a strong team culture, and leading hiring efforts when relevant

• Occasionally personally help drive a small number of the most critical technical programs when their strategic importance, complexity, or ambiguity calls for direct senior influence 

• Evolve the team structure, strategy, functions, and roles and responsibilities to continuously meet Stripe’s evolving business needs 

• Transmit and foster our values, serving as a beacon of Stripe’s user-centric philosophy and culture of transparency, empathy, inclusion, and empowerment

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience managing program managers who lead complex, cross-functional technical programs

• Experience partnering directly with product and engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle and/or go-to-market

• Sufficient technical proficiency to clarify architecture, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks, enabling Engineering and Product leaders to set informed technical direction 

• Excellent analytical skills; you digest complex information and make recommendations 

• Very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams and senior leaders around the organization

Preferred qualifications

•  Experience working in financial risk and compliance and/or at comparable tech companies

title: Sr. Product Manager, Lending
description:

Our goal is to make difficult financial decisions simple and increase accessibility to fair, affordable, and transparent medical financing. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 15,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

• Scratch Pay: Point-of-sale lending, including a BNPL offering and longer-term payment plans

• Scratch Checkout: Payment processing that is integrated with the veterinary practice management software

The role

We are seeking an experienced Structured Cabling Design Engineer to support the design and delivery of structured cabling and physical network infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data center environments.

This remote position will be responsible for developing scalable, standards-compliant fiber and copper cabling designs from concept through construction and deployment. The engineer will work closely with data center design, network engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and deployment teams to ensure cabling infrastructure meets capacity, reliability, maintainability, and future-growth requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop end-to-end structured cabling designs for new-build, expansion, retrofit, and capacity-add data center projects.

• Design fiber-optic and copper cabling systems supporting data center network, compute, storage, management, security, and building infrastructure.

• Develop MDF, IDF, MMR, network room, meet-me-room, and data hall connectivity designs .

• Create fiber backbone, horizontal cabling, interconnect, cross-connect, and equipment connectivity architectures.

• Develop single-line diagrams, cabling schematics, rack elevations, patching diagrams, pathway layouts, fiber routing plans, and connectivity schedules .

• Determine fiber counts, cable types, connector types, patch-panel requirements, termination methods, and pathway capacity.

• Design solutions using single-mode and multimode fiber , including high-density fiber connectivity and MPO/MTP-based systems where applicable.

• Specify Category 6/6A copper infrastructure and associated patching systems.

• Perform cable pathway, tray, conduit, ladder rack, and containment capacity calculations.

• Coordinate structured cabling requirements with network architecture, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, and construction disciplines.

• Review construction drawings, BIM/CAD models, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and vendor proposals.

• Develop Bills of Materials (BOMs) and support material forecasting and procurement.

• Create and maintain cabling standards, design guidelines, naming conventions, labeling requirements, and installation specifications.

• Ensure designs comply with applicable TIA, BICSI, IEEE, NEC/NFPA, ISO/IEC, and manufacturer standards .

• Support data center capacity planning and determine future fiber, copper, rack, and pathway requirements.

• Review contractor installation packages and ensure field implementation aligns with approved designs.

• Support fiber testing, copper certification, commissioning, punch-list resolution, and project closeout.

• Review OTDR, insertion-loss, and certification test results where applicable.

• Participate remotely in design reviews, construction coordination meetings, and technical troubleshooting.

• Conduct occasional site surveys and field inspections when required.

• Identify design risks, constructability issues, capacity constraints, and opportunities for standardization.

• Maintain accurate as-built documentation, cable schedules, port assignments, rack elevations, and connectivity records .

• Work across multiple concurrent data center projects while maintaining design qu

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Summary
Provides senior-level accounting support for Molina's Texas Health Plan, including month-end close, account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, statutory reporting, audit support, and accounting schedule preparation. Applies quality principles in the areas of: design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation, program performance, reliability, inventory control, and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality for make and/or buy products. • Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

• Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are

You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skill

title: Senior SDET - Test Automation & Performance Engineering | Contract | Remote MX
description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies - from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms - and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:
We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.
Key Responsibilities:

• Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams

• Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate

• Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies

• Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments

• Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests

• Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds

• Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates

• Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds

• Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests

• Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues

• Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies

• Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations

• Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness

• Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios

• Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk

• Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

• Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role

• Strong software development and test automation skills

• Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications

• Hands-on experience working within AWS environments

• Strong experience building automated API and integration test frameworks

• Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent

• Experience designing realistic performance workloads rather than simply executing predefined load tests

title: Chief Impact Officer
description:
The Chief Impact Officer is responsible for developing and leading the organization's social impact, sustainability, ESG, and purpose-driven initiatives. The role focuses on creating measurable positive outcomes for communities, stakeholders, customers, employees, and the environment while aligning impact objectives with the organization's long-term business strategy. The CIO drives programs that enhance corporate responsibility, sustainable growth, and stakeholder value.
Key Responsibilities
Impact Strategy & Vision

• Develop and execute the organization's impact strategy aligned with corporate mission and business objectives.

• Define measurable social, environmental, and economic impact goals.

• Integrate impact priorities into enterprise-wide strategic planning.

ESG & Sustainability Leadership

• Lead ESG, sustainability, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.

• Ensure alignment of impact programs with sustainability frameworks and best practices.

• Drive initiatives focused on climate action, social inclusion, and responsible governance.

Social Impact & Community Engagement

• Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures for impact performance.

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships

• Engage with investors, clients, regulators, community leaders, and advocacy groups.

• Build strategic partnerships that strengthen organizational impact and reputation.

• Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

Sustainable Business Integration

• Collaborate with business units to embed impact principles into products, services, and operations.

• Support responsible investment and sustainable business initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to create shared value through innovation and strategic growth.

Governance & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with ESG, sustainability, and social responsibility standards and regulations.

• Establish governance frameworks to support accountability and transparency.

• Coordinate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams.

Employee Engagement & Culture

• Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.

• Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.

• Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

Leadership & Organizational Development

• Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.

• Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Public Policy, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or related field; Master's degree preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in ESG, sustainability, social impact, CSR, or related leadership roles.

• Proven experience developing and implementing impact-focused initiatives and strategies.

• Strong strategic and purpose-driven leadership skills.

• Expertise in ESG, sustainability, and social impact measurement.

• Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities.

• Strong analytical and program management skills.

• Change management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

Performance Metrics

• Achievement of social and environmental impact goals.

• ESG and sustainability performance outcomes.

• Community engagement and partnership effectiveness

title: Internal Communications Lead
description:
TL;DR

This is a strategic operating role at the center of the company, reporting to the Head of Comms with a dotted line to our Cofounder and CEO. Your core job is making sure company leadership communication is clear, consistent, and compounding week after week as we scale. Around that core, you'll own the narrative, the moments, and the rhythms that keep a fast-growing global team aligned, and you'll run the programming lean, with AI doing the production work so your judgment goes where it matters most.

The challenge: when a company doubles in a year across offices and oceans, shared context is the first thing that can break. The warmth of a small team gets diluted by process. Your job is to make sure none of that happens: that every person at Lovable knows where we're going, why, and their part in it, and hears it in a voice that still feels like us.

WHY LOVABLE

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Be the CEO's communications partner. You'll help make sure what the company hears is consistent from week to week and compounds over quarters. And you'll be a genuine advisor: in the room early, pressure-testing how a decision will land before it's made, and holding a mirror up to leadership when the message and the reality drift apart.

Own the company narrative and operating rhythm. You'll own recurring communications and the strategy behind them: the cadences that ensure every employee understands the strategy, the priorities, and the reasoning, not just the announcements. You'll connect the internal story to the external one so employees hear one narrative, whether it comes from the CEO, their manager, or the press.

Run the moments that matter. Fundraises, strategy rollouts, reorgs and leadership changes, and other high-stakes comms. You'll partner with the Office of the CEO and leadership team to make sure these moments are planned, humane, and land without whiplash: employees hear things that affect them before any rumor mill does.

Make our flagship forums worth showing up for. You'll own the editorial arc of company-wide all-hands, elevate the craft of everyone presenting, and keep these moments warm and personal as we grow past the size where that happens by default.

Build an AI-native internal comms engine. You'll run programming that would traditionally take a team, alone, by defaulting to AI and Lovable itself for input gathering, chasing, aggregating, drafting, and measurement. Human judgment stays where it belongs: editorial calls, sensitive moments, and final approval. If you're still doing production work manually after three months, something has gone wrong.

Raise the bar for how leaders communicate. At Lovable, functions own their own communication; internal comms is not a gatekeeper or a wordsmithing service. Your job is to make every leader and manager a better

title: Senior Software Engineer, Object Storage - DGX Cloud
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Object Storage to design, implement, and extend the capabilities of our internal object storage system. This system is a core service that is critical to NVIDIA AI/ML research teams creating best of breed generative AI systems and pioneering world models. We are looking for a software developer who has a deep understanding of object storage, outstanding architecture and design skills and a track record in writing and delivering large-scale storage services.
What You Will Be Doing:

• Contributing to the design, development, and testing of our object storage system

• Developing storage capabilities to support NVIDIA research teams and other users

• Extending the availability and reliability of our deployments at scale - 10k+ nodes, exabytes of data

• Analyzing and improving system performance at all levels

• Automating storage infrastructure end-to-end including provisioning, management and monitoring

• Making contributions upstream to open source storage codebases

What We Need To See:

• Consistent track record of developing object storage services and an understanding of strategies for addressing data availability, durability, and fault tolerance

• History of ownership of product delivery from inception to support

• Great communication and presentation skills

• Prior experience developing distributed systems with Python, Go, C/C++, or similar

• Bachelor’s of Science in Computer Science, or related field or equivalent experience

• 8+ yrs of relevant experience

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• You have developed and delivered major components of a distributed storage system that has been deployed at exabyte scale

• Strong experience with concurrency models and primitives (threads, event loops, distributed locking, etc.)

• Skilled with building and delivering cloud services, with specific focus on storage or data systems. You have made sustained contributions to open source projects

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. We are looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . •

Proven records in systematic trading including market making and other systematic trading strategies.

•
Deep understanding of cryptocurrency delta1 products and basic knowledge of the cryptocurrency product is a plus.

•
Proficient in at least one programming language (Python/Java/RUST/C++).

•
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and make rational decisions under pressure.

•
Good communication skills.

 

What We Offer

•
World-class connections to major cryptocurrency exchanges and ultra-low latency trading system.

•
User friendly strategy containers enable very easy and fast implementation, backtesting, and deployment of trading strategies.

•
Top notch quant development team providing support in state-of-the-art infrastructure, robust strategy implementations, and data service.

•
A chance to work and exchange ideas with brilliant ex-banking/ex-fund traders from various backgrounds.

•
Very competitive remuneration package structure.

Competitive total compensation package

•
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•
Wellness and meal allowances 

•
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants 

•
More that we love to tell you along the process!

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
About Fyxer
Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.
The Mission
At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution .
We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who uses research, data, and experimentation to drive better bets, faster learning, and stronger commercial outcomes. We’re not looking for someone to write specs and hand over insights. We want someone who helps us think better and decide better.
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain alongside our product, growth and leadership teams.

The Role
You’ll drive product vision and strategy of a product domain / category design alongside our product / growth and leadership teams.
You will operate at speed. We care about generating signals quickly, making informed decisions, and learning fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening thinking as you go.
You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes and a fullstack background around A/B experimentation and everything that comes with it.
What you will own:
You will own the quality of our product bets and the speed at which we learn.

• Turn ambiguity into direction. Take messy signals from customers, product data, and the market and translate them into clear problem framing and product strategy.

• Work directly with engineers. You will partner closely with engineers and founders from the start of an initiative, shaping solutions together rather than handing over specs.

• Use the right tools to validate ideas and reduce risk: interviews, prototypes, experiments, product analytics, fake doors, usability testing, and behavioural analysis

• Ship, learn, and iterate quickly. Move product bets from idea to shipped product to measurable outcomes, continuously tightening the loop between learning and building.

• Raise the bar of product thinking across the team by coaching others, introducing scalable frameworks, and helping the team stay close to customers

Who You Are

• Expert: You are an expert in your domain specialization that everyone could learn from including our other PM’s

• Systems thinker: You understand customer journeys, funnels, and feedback loops. You connect user behaviour to outcomes and revenue impact, not just isolated features.

• Engineering partner : You work closely with engineers and founders, translating user insight into clear problem framing and practical tradeoffs. You influence what we build through evidence and clarity.

• Decision oriented : You know when there is enough signal to move. You help others clarify thinking, sharpen hypotheses, and make confident calls under uncertainty.

• Capability builder: You design product systems that compound over time rather than one off projects. Your work levels up how we do product and discovery across the company, and you introduce frameworks, coach others, and build repeatable learning loops.

Why Fyxer?
We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

• Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

• Scope: This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage..

• Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

Compensation Range: £140K - £180K

title: Sotftware Tester (QA) - InteleShare
description:
As a Software Tester on the InteleShare team, you'll safeguard the quality of the platform that healthcare providers use to share and exchange medical imaging. Working across the full testing lifecycle, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to catch issues before they reach customers, strengthen our automation practices, and help ensure every release meets the reliability our industry demands.
The work is automation-first. InteleShare is covered by a BDD test framework written in Java 17 and Maven - Cucumber feature files driving Selenium page objects for the web UI and Rest-Assured clients for the APIs, with Allure and ExtentReports for results and Jira Xray for test management - executed against nine application components and nine environments through GitHub Actions. You will write and own tests in that framework, not just execute them manually.
Key Responsibilities

• Test Planning & Execution: Participate in the full testing lifecycle - requirements validation, test planning, and test case development - through functional, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, covering image sharing and exchange workflows end to end: DICOM ingestion and retrieval, HL7-driven order and report flows, storage backends, viewer behaviour, and the web application.

• Automation & Process Improvement: Write and maintain automated tests in the InteleShare framework - Gherkin feature files, Java step definitions, Selenium page objects, and Rest-Assured API tests - and improve the framework's reliability, coverage, and testability within an Agile Scrum environment.

• CI & Test Operations: Run and triage regression suites through GitHub Actions across components, environments, browsers, and operating systems; keep results flowing into Jira Xray with useful evidence; and drive down flaky tests so failures mean something.

• Defect Management: Identify, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and evidence, maintaining traceability in Jira/Xray from business requirements and technical specifications through test cases and executions to resolution.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to formulate test scenarios, reproduce customer escalations, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and support post-release and post-implementation testing.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Interact with clients and internal stakeholders to understand product requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.

Qualifications & Experience

• Up-to-date knowledge of software test design and testing methodologies

• 2+ years of experience as a Software Tester or QA Analyst on web applications, including hands-on test automation, or equivalent experience.

• Experience with project management principles and QA methodology

• Working knowledge of test management tooling (Jira with Xray, or equivalents such as qTest or Zephyr) and of SQL for verifying data directly in the database (PostgreSQL).

• Enough programming ability to write and maintain automated tests in an object-oriented language - Java preferred, since the InteleShare framework is Java/Maven - and comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull request reviews.

• Ability to investigate a failure below the UI: reading application logs, inspecting REST/JSON requests and responses, and using browser developer tools.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

• Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing

• Hands-on experience with Selenium and a BDD framework (Cucumber/Gherkin), and with API test automation (Rest-Assured, Postman, or similar).

• Experience running automated suites in CI (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and working with test reporting tools such as Allure or ExtentReports.

• Cross-browser and cross-platform test experience (Chrome and Firefox on Linux,

title: Proposal Pricing Analyst

DT Pro is seeking a collaborative and detail-oriented Proposal Pricing Analyst to own pricing strategy for government proposals from pre-RFP through submission. In this role, you’ll work closely with teammates across business development, capture, contracts, finance, and operations to build compliant, competitive, and well-documented pricing. You’ll help ensure pricing decisions support both regulatory requirements and business goals, balancing competitiveness, compliance, and smart risk-taking throughout the proposal process.
Responsibilities:

• Develop detailed cost and price models for government proposals, including labor, materials, subcontractors, and indirect rates.

• Ensure compliance with FAR 15.403 and 15.408 requirements for Certified Cost or Pricing Data, including preparation and support of required certifications.

• Ensure all pricing is compliant with FAR, DFARS, and agency-specific regulations.

• Analyze historical cost data, labor rate structures, and indirect rate forecasts to inform pricing strategies.

• Develop, distribute and follow up on pricing data calls for subcontractor/teaming partners.

• Prepare pricing narratives, cost volumes, and supporting documentation for proposal submissions.

• Support fact-finding, audits, and negotiations with government contracting officers and DCAA/DCMA.

• Collaborate with contracts and legal teams to assess risk and ensure contractual compliance.

• Maintain pricing templates, tools, and standard work instructions to improve efficiency and consistency.

• Participate in proposal reviews to validate accuracy, competitiveness, and compliance.

• Review Requests for Proposals (RFP) and proposal documents for compliance to customer specifications/requirements and adherence to company policy.

• Support various business management and operations functions.

• 3+ years of relevant experience.

• Must have exceptional communication skills.

• Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS cost principles and compliance requirements.

• Experience supporting compliance with FAR 15.403 and 15.408 requirements for certified Cost or Pricing Data, including preparation of required certifications.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.

• Experience conducting salary surveys

• Ability to work under tight deadlines in a proposal-driven environment.

• Familiarity with conducting price to win analysiscost estimating software (e.g., PROPRICER, Deltek Costpoint).

• Experience working with large, complex IDIQ, CPFF, T&M, and FFP contracts.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, PhD, Safety Research, Human Behavior Analytics
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Human Behavior Analytics (HBA) team, part of the Waymo Safety team, conducts research and development on computational road user behavior models and other methods and tools used for evaluating the behavior and safety of the Waymo Driver. This work typically exists at the intersection between AI/ML and cognitive science and is done in close collaboration with other Waymo teams, in particular SW Research, Systems Engineering, Simulation and Data Science. The HBA team also engages extensively in research with external academic partners.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Survey the state-of-the-art in digital neuroscience / cognitive science and mechanistic interpretability

• Develop models able to represent some select aspects of human driving behavior not typically accounted for by existing data-driven ML models (e.g., collision avoidance, road user interaction or visual behavior)

• Explore and demonstrate different ways in which the internal mechanisms of these models can be interpreted and explained

 

You have:

• A strong research background and expertise in cognitive science and / or neuroscience

• Expertise in contemporary AI and machine learning

• Strong documented computational skills (math and coding)

 

We prefer:

• Specific experience from research on mechanistic interpretability

General Perks:

• Help solve challenging problems with a direct impact on the company

• Competitive compensation packages with a housing/relocation bonus (if applicable)

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Fun intern events and networking opportunities

Onsite Perks:

• Free breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks 

• Free access to Google shuttles

• Onsite gym

 

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.
